metadata.description: Executable TensorsLab image and video API skills, plus a local review-first planner for ecommerce and campaign production.

plugins.name: tl-image
plugins.description: Submit TensorsLab text-to-image or image-to-image tasks, validate parameters, preview requests, poll status, and save results locally.

plugins.name: tl-video
plugins.description: Submit TensorsLab text-to-video or image-to-video tasks, validate model-specific parameters, preview requests, poll status, and save results locally.

plugins.name: miaodashi-workshop
plugins.description: Create reviewable ecommerce image/video plans, approve them locally, prepare exact TensorsLab client commands, and record QA with selective retries.
